programme.desc: An intense rivalry ensues between two brothers after their daughters fall in love with their driver. However, things take a drastic turn after their rivalry becomes a matter of their family prestige.

programme.title: Kottayam Kunjachan
programme.desc: Kottayam Kunjachan, a small-time thug, gets out of jail after serving a term of seven years for killing a person. Once out, he tries to lead a good life but gets embroiled in a family feud.

programme.title: Out of Syllabus
programme.desc: When village boy Gopikrishnan goes to study in a city college, he is bullied by his classmates. Namitha supports him through his difficult phase and they develop a close bond.

programme.title: Simon Peter Ninakku Vendi
programme.desc: Smuggler Simon Peter falls in love with Alice. However, he becomes the target of a gangster when he tries to cease the illegal activities carried out in the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Sadgamaya
programme.desc: Ravi Varman, a psychiatrist, treats only one patient at a time and that too in isolation. When he learns that his former patient Yamuna is getting married, he decides to meet her.

programme.title: Ellarum Chollanu
programme.desc: A man borrows money to go to Dubai and assures his moneylenders visas and jobs in return. Instead, he vanishes and promises to reopen a mill that has been shut down when they demand their money back.

programme.title: Kuruppinte Kanakkupusthakam
programme.desc: Vinayan, a rich businessman, tries to help everyone in need and always takes care of his family. However, things take an ugly turn when during a fight he accuses his wife of being infertile.

programme.title: Calcutta News
programme.desc: Ajit, an anchor in Kolkata, meets Krishnapriya, who has lost her husband under mysterious circumstances. However, things become complicated when he falls for her while helping to find her spouse.

programme.title: Rappakal

programme.title: Mayamayooram
